lastResponse.text: Yes, I am asking if you’re safe right now. Thank you for telling me. With no sleep and voices, this is urgent. If you might hurt yourself or anyone else, or feel in immediate danger, call nine one one right now. If you can stay with me, I’m connecting you to a live crisis counselor now.

slottedCanonicalQueryTemplates: Wait, what did you ask me, are you asking if I’m safe right now? I mean I locked the door, but I haven’t slept in two days and I can’t keep my thoughts in order.
